references.text: Parallel text in Exodus giving instructions to boil the flesh of the consecration offering and eat it at the entrance of the tent of meeting, along with the bread in the basket.
Continuation of the consecration ceremony where Aaron and his sons must remain at the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days.
Instructions that the priests shall eat what remains of the grain offering as unleavened bread in a holy place.
Rules stating that the flesh of the thank offering must be eaten on the same day it is offered.
Moses gives similar instructions to Aaron and his surviving sons to eat the grain offering and the breast offering at the sanctuary.
Reference to the entrance of the tent of meeting as the place for the consecration of Aaron and his sons.
